versions.content: Ownership of GlobalTimeGateway Since the existence of a GlobalTimeGateway is only justified if a GlobalTimeDomain exists that is refer- enced by a GlobalTimeDomain in the role globalTimeSubDomain it seems appro- priate to aggregate the GlobalTimeGateway at the GlobalTimeDomain referenced in the role globalTimeSubDomain .
